% Figure 4.3 (fig:space): memory footprint (MB) vs non-zeros, engine vs cuSPARSE CSR,
% up to the crossover_synth point (1.00G nnz), where CSR still fits the GB10's unified
% pool. Data in data/fig_space.dat is GENERATED by ../../extract_results.py from the
% logs; rerun the extractor to refresh.
% Columns: nnz  eng_mb  cus_mb  oom  label   (cus_mb = nan if a run ever OOMs).
\documentclass[tikz]{standalone}
\usepackage{pgfplots}
\pgfplotsset{compat=1.16}
\usepackage{xcolor}
\definecolor{cEngine}{HTML}{E66101}   % warm orange
\definecolor{cCusparse}{HTML}{5E3C99} % deep purple
\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{axis}[
    font=\footnotesize,
    width=10.5cm, height=6.2cm,
    xmode=log, ymode=log,
    xlabel={Number of Non-Zeros (NNZ)},
    ylabel={Memory Footprint (MB)},
    grid=both, major grid style={gray!25}, minor grid style={gray!10},
    legend pos=north west, legend cell align=left,
    scatter/classes={%
        e={mark=*,cEngine}, c={mark=square*,cCusparse}, o={mark=x,red,mark size=4pt}},
]
% cuSPARSE CSR footprint (only rows that did not OOM; nan rows are dropped by pgfplots).
\addplot[only marks, cCusparse, mark=square*, mark size=2.2pt]
    table[x=nnz, y=cus_mb] {data/fig_space.dat};
\addlegendentry{cuSPARSE CSR}
% Grammar engine footprint (all rows).
\addplot[only marks, cEngine, mark=*, mark size=2.2pt]
    table[x=nnz, y=eng_mb] {data/fig_space.dat};
\addlegendentry{Grammar Engine (Ours)}

\end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
